name: Inspect Destiny process state
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,etime,args | grep -E '[p]odman|[c]onmon|[u]pload.py|[h]elmd' | head -100
podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format 'status={{.State.Status}} pid={{.State.Pid}} started={{.State.StartedAt}} finished={{.State.FinishedAt}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} error={{.State.Error}} restart={{.RestartCount}}' 2>&1 || true
podman exec upload-assistant-wastaken sh -c 'tr "\\0" " " < /proc/1/cmdline; echo; cat /proc/1/status | grep -E "^State|^Sig"' 2>&1 || true
REMOTE
description: Inspect Destiny’s current container and host supervisor state after the login reset restart.
